column1: # plumOS MF libretro core build recipes.
#   B: baseline CPU-rendered core set validated before accelerated GPU work.
#   W: wider CPU-rendered core set validated one system at a time on Bubble.
#   V: V90S CPU catalog candidate awaiting MF real-device validation.
# Every source revision is immutable. Add wider or GPU-dependent cores only
# after the baseline set has live MF display, audio, input, exit and save proof.
# Wider CPU-rendered cores. Each row remains outside the baseline filter until
# its own Bubble runtime cycle is complete.
# Second CPU-rendered expansion, carried from the V90S/A30 source recipes.
# V90S default CPU catalog expansion. These keep the V90S/A30 proven source
# revisions, but are rebuilt in the Bubble AArch64 toolchain and remain candidates
# until the Bubble mechanical runtime cycle passes.
# Remaining A30/V90S catalog. Moving refs such as HEAD and release tags are
# pinned to the last successful V90S commits. Flycast Xtreme uses the current
# reachable commit because the V90S package's staged commit was removed upstream.
